criteria.evidence: UploadScreen has hero, stickers, card 'PDF or DOCX · up to 5 MB', two secondary buttons and footer; UploadScreenTest plus prototype and 337dp/2.0 baselines.

OpenDocument with resumeMimeTypes(); no storage permission (ManifestNoStoragePermissionTest); cancelled pick does nothing. Bytes are read in memory by the unchanged ContentResolverResumeTextSource, no temp files.
ReadingViewModel percent is 0/40/100 by stage; rows and counts tested; no back (BackHandler consumes). Row meta is folded into the label above font 1.3, which wraps at spaces only.
Done event replaces Reading with Review; OnboardingNavigationTest covers it.

Failures land on Unreadable; copy is file-specific only for image-only, unreadable and oversize files, neutral for parse and save failures; 5 MB is cited from the issue and prototype card. A file whose parse is empty shows the file copy (low finding).
Choose another file and Paste as text on Unreadable; UnreadableViewModelTest and OnboardingNavigationTest.
Paste screen with Read text enabled at 50 characters, text capped at 30,000; PasteResumeViewModelTest.
Manual screen has six fields and saves, but the read-only email is clipped at 337dp/font 2.0 in manual_narrow-337-font-200_dark.png, which breaks D40 on a screen this PR ships.

Imported entries are saved unconfirmed with source IMPORTED and reviewedAt null (I.1 met). Ids are unique only against entries currently in the profile, so re-import and manual add reuse ids of removed facts, contrary to the never-reuse-ids rule (#321).
ResumeImportDraft is in memory, cleared on consume, failure and account change; NoResumeTextLoggedTest scans onboarding sources; only parsed profile and file name are stored.
Narrow baselines exist for all five screens, but the Manual baseline records a clipped email.

OnboardingRealEntryHiltTest renders the real entries with Hilt view models (D55, D57); placeholder keys removed in OnboardingEntryKeysTest. Fixture commit 3f57a377 touches only the entry fixtures in continuationsKeepLinkAfterReid; no assertion changed.

findings.rule: I.1 truth; ids never reused (#321 / D52 follow-up)
findings.trigger: Profile has imported W-02 'Old role' used by a saved application; the user re-imports a new resume. The old IMPORTED entries are dropped and allocation runs against kept entries only, so the new import gets W-02 'New role'. The old application's fact reference now resolves to a different fact. reimportReplacesOnlyImportedEntries asserts exactly this reuse. SaveManualProfileUseCase line 35 has the same defect after the user deletes a role.
findings.title: Re-import and manual save reuse ids of removed facts
findings.proof: Save a profile with imported W-02, run invoke(parsed) with a different Work entry, assert the new id is not W-02 (or not in any prior id set).

findings.rule: D40: no ellipsis, clip or mid-word break on these screens
findings.trigger: Fill in myself at 337dp with font scale 2.0 and a 25-character email: the read-only TmrTextField shows 'priya.deshmukh@gm' and the rest is cut (see manual_narrow-337-font-200_dark.png). The PR lists this as a follow-up, but the screen ships here, so it is a finding.
findings.title: Read-only email field clips at 337dp / font 2.0 on the shipped Manual screen

findings.rule: I.1 truth: nothing claimed that was not found
findings.trigger: A resume with no name, email or phone parses to only skills: the Contact details row still ends as 'Found' because Contact has a null count and the meta is unconditional.
findings.title: Contact row says Found even when no contact detail was parsed

findings.rule: D60: file blamed only when the file is at fault
findings.trigger: A PDF whose text is extracted fine but the parser returns nothing: the screen says 'We couldn't open this file or find any text in it', which is untrue for the extracted text. Neutral copy fits a parser result.
findings.title: Empty parse of a readable file uses the file-blaming copy

findings.trigger: resumeFileFor runs contentResolver.query inside the picker result callback on the main thread; a slow DocumentsProvider (cloud-backed) can block the UI. The same call is at UnreadableScreen.kt line 163.
findings.title: Content resolver query for file name and size runs on the main thread
